proposed_function: mediates protein-protein interaction with Grb2 SH3 domain via polyproline II helix
evidence: a previously described complex of Grb2 with Gab1 (497–528) shows an extended polyproline II‑helix, which is analogous to other SH3‑mediated complexes such as CD2AP_2:RIN, Fyn:App12, and p40phox:p47phox.

evidence: We have recently reported that PADI4 binds to RYBP [36] and the RAWUL domain of RING1B, C-RING1B (residues 228-336 of the intact protein) [37], modifying some of the arginines in those polypeptides.

proposed_function: Mediates protein‑protein self‑assembly into micelles and phase‑separated droplets
evidence: In unphosphorylated TDP-43 LCD, contacts are broadly distributed along the sequence, with 2-2 interactions dominating, followed by 2–3, while 1-1 contacts are less frequent, likely due to the modest net positive charge of block 1.
